# Storefront Studio

> Fixed-price websites for US local businesses (barbers, salons, restaurants, dentists, contractors and more), live the same day. Free homepage concept before payment. Starter $1,200 (founding $960), Standard $2,000 (founding $1,600), care plan $79/month. 50% deposit, refundable if the first design isn't liked.

Contact: +1 (614) 967-9783 (AI assistant, 24/7), huszageorge25@gmail.com

## Guides
- [How Much Does a Small Business Website Cost in 2026?](https://huszageorge25-wq.github.io/guides/small-business-website-cost/): Honest price ranges for small business websites in the US: website builders, freelancers, agencies and fixed-price studios, plus what you should get for the money.
- [Google Business Profile Checklist for Local Businesses](https://huszageorge25-wq.github.io/guides/google-business-profile-checklist/): A plain-English checklist to get more calls from Google Maps: categories, hours, photos, reviews, and how your website supports your profile.
- [The 12-Point Website Checklist for Local Businesses](https://huszageorge25-wq.github.io/guides/local-business-website-checklist/): Check your current website in five minutes. Twelve things every local business website needs so people on their phones call, book or visit.
